tagline: Use Canva to earn online — even if you've never studied design.

summary.description: Canva is one of the easiest tools to turn into income. Thousands of small businesses need social media graphics, flyers, presentations, and menus — but can't afford a professional designer. If you can make clean, readable designs in Canva, you already have a marketable skill.
who_is_this_for: People who enjoy making graphics or social media posts
Stay-at-home parents who want flexible, creative work
Anyone who already uses Canva for personal projects
summary.reality_check: Canva design is a low-barrier skill, which means competition is high. Your first gigs will pay ₱100–₱500 per design. The path to higher income requires specializing (e.g. real estate flyers, restaurant menus) or bundling design with social media management. Speed matters more than perfection.

roadmap.title: Set Up

steps.detail: The free plan is enough to start. Don't pay for Pro until you're earning from it.

steps.action: Build a portfolio of 10 sample designs
steps.detail: Make 3 social media posts, 3 flyers, 2 presentations, and 2 menus. Use real-looking brand names. Save them as a PDF or link to your Canva profile.

steps.action: Set up profiles on Fiverr and OnlineJobsPH
steps.detail: On Fiverr, create a gig: 'I will design social media graphics in Canva.' On OnlineJobsPH, search for 'graphic designer' or 'social media assistant.'

roadmap.milestone: Portfolio of 10 designs ready and profiles live

steps.detail: Find restaurants, salons, or shops with weak social media. Send: 'I made a sample post for your page — here it is. I can do more for ₱500/week.'
Search 'Canva designer Philippines' or 'VA hiring PH.' Post your portfolio. Many clients recruit from these groups.
Create 3 free posts for one business. If they like it, propose a weekly package.

steps.action: Create branded templates for each client
steps.detail: Save their colors, fonts, and logo as Canva brand kits. This speeds up your work and makes clients dependent on you.

steps.action: Bundle design with social media posting
steps.detail: Offer: 'I'll design 12 posts/month AND schedule them for ₱3,000–₱5,000.' Bundling increases your value per client.
If a client asks for 24-hour turnaround, deliver in 12. Speed builds trust and referrals.

roadmap.title: Increase Your Income

steps.detail: Pick restaurants, real estate, or fitness. Industry-specific portfolios win more clients than generic ones.

steps.action: Sell Canva templates on Gumroad or Etsy
steps.detail: Create template packs (e.g. '30 Instagram templates for cafes') and sell them for ₱200–₱500 each. Passive income.
After 10+ completed projects, increase by 30%. New clients won't know your old rate. Good clients stay.

roadmap.milestone: Earning ₱15,000+/month from design work and template sales

income_paths.title: Social Media Graphics
income_paths.detail: Design Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok posts for businesses. Most common starting point. Clients pay per batch or monthly retainer.

income_paths.title: Presentations & Pitch Decks
income_paths.detail: Create professional slides for startups, agencies, and corporate clients. Higher pay per project. Requires understanding layout and storytelling.

income_paths.title: Print Design (Menus, Flyers, Brochures)
income_paths.detail: Design materials for restaurants, events, and local businesses. Often leads to ongoing relationships when menus or promos change seasonally.

income_paths.title: Template Selling
income_paths.detail: Create and sell reusable Canva template packs on Gumroad, Etsy, or Creative Market. Build once, sell repeatedly.

platforms.name: Fiverr
platforms.why: Best for selling packaged design services. Clients browse and buy directly — less pitching required.

platforms.name: OnlineJobsPH
platforms.why: Many Philippine businesses look for Canva-skilled VAs here. Often leads to long-term employment.

platforms.name: Facebook Groups
platforms.why: Direct access to local businesses. Post samples and respond to hiring posts in Filipino freelancer groups.

platforms.name: Gumroad
platforms.why: Sell Canva template packs. No upfront cost. You keep most of the revenue.

tools.name: Canva
tools.purpose: Your primary design tool. Free plan covers most client needs.

tools.name: Unsplash
tools.purpose: Free stock photos for your designs. Commercial use allowed.

tools.name: Coolors
tools.purpose: Generate color palettes that look professional. Helpful when clients have no brand colors.

tools.name: Google Drive
tools.purpose: Organize and share design files with clients.

faq.question: Can I really earn from Canva without formal design training?
faq.answer: Yes. Most clients hiring Canva designers are small businesses who need clean, simple graphics — not award-winning art. If you can follow brand guidelines and create readable layouts, you qualify.

faq.question: Should I pay for Canva Pro?
faq.answer: Not yet. Start with the free plan. Upgrade to Pro (₱500/month) only when you need the background remover, brand kits, or premium templates — usually after your first few paying clients.

faq.question: How many designs can I realistically produce per day?
faq.answer: A beginner can produce 5–10 social media posts per day. With templates and brand kits saved, experienced designers produce 15–20. Speed increases with repetition.

faq.question: What if a client asks for something beyond Canva's capability?
faq.answer: Be honest. Say: 'This needs Photoshop/Illustrator, which is outside my current tools.' Clients respect honesty. You can learn Figma (free) for more complex work later.

faq.question: Is Canva design a long-term career?
faq.answer: Canva design alone has a ceiling. The long-term path is using Canva as a starting point, then expanding into social media management, brand strategy, or learning professional tools like Figma.
